struct-literal-key.comment: Struct literal keys (ID: 1, Title: "hello", Addr: ":8080") are unscoped. They are the Go equivalent of a named argument.

member-call.comment: Method calls after a dot (c.JSON, s.mu.RLock, time.Now) carry no scope in Go's grammar.

member-access.comment: Field and constant access after a dot (c.Request, http.StatusOK, gin.HandlerFunc).

qualifier.comment: The head of a selector chain - a package name (slog, http, time) or a receiver (c, s, logger).

short-declaration.comment: Go leaves the targets of a short declaration (article, err := ...) completely unscoped. Tag each name in the comma list.

var-declaration.comment: var ErrNotFound = ... / var payload Article - the declared name is unscoped.

value-identifier.comment: Bare identifiers used as values inside a call or list - errors.Is(err, ErrNotFound), signal.Notify(quit, ...). Go scopes none of these. Excludes keywords, builtin types and builtin functions, and anything followed by '.', '(' or ':' so qualifiers, calls and labels keep their own colours.
